title: Phòng nhạc cũ
about: Round x10, for sleep with improvised melodies (style ngu-ngon), as the user asked to go on ("ok chúng ta hãy tiếp tục sáng tác nhạc"), on the sounds the user liked most: an old music room at night: the music box improvising, the low strings soft and close under it, a deep sub. F sharp minor. No drums, plucked string or organ. An original piece; its melody made up by the improviser in dark/ambient.py.
